note: Tiny park near the Mississippi River at Altenburg, opened late 2025: two pull-throughs on the upper level by the bathhouse, two sites on the lower level; hiking trails, a fishing pond and a picnic area. Veterans camp free for three nights. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms 4 sites (2 full-hookup pull-throughs, 2 water/electric), phone booking, showers/laundry and a veterans' three-free-nights offer; no rate posted. Presence passes on the working site + phone; price rests only on a thin RV Life $ tier. Weak spot.
flags: Private gates - WEAK on price: no rate posted on the operator site; Google shows no rating or reviews; RV Life tags price_level 1 ($) but its avg_rate is $0 and its only review (12/2025) paid '$0 USD a night, discount Military' (the free veterans' offer). Presence passes (working operator website riverhillsrvpark.com + phone 573-270-7451, the stored phone). The $ tier formally satisfies the price test, but no nightly figure exists anywhere; a human may want a phone call. Newly opened (late 2025, per the RV Life reviewer); also listed on Harvest Hosts per that reviewer. No gateway within 40 km (Cape Girardeau ~30 km is not a gateway); family has not stayed. Not long-stay in character.
Amperage not stated; max rig not stated (the RV Life reviewer brought a 43-ft motorhome with toad - 'big-rig friendly ... somewhat tight setting').

Pin 37.6272,-89.5994 is ~45 m from Google's pin (37.62763,-89.59910) at the 95 Hwy C commercial lot; Esri imagery predates the park so the pads aren't visible. No move. Only a fishing pond (under 5 acres); 'not waterfront' stands.
